name: Turkey (Deli)
siboNotes: Plain deli turkey is naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated. Check labels for added garlic, onion powder, or high FODMAP seasonings.
preparationTips: Choose plain, unseasoned varieties when possible
Read ingredient labels carefully for garlic or onion powder
Look for nitrate-free options to reduce additives
Store properly and consume within 3-5 days of opening
nutritionalHighlights: Good source of B vitamins, especially B6 and B12
Low in saturated fat when skin is removed
